incidents.summary: Volex disclosed a cyber incident involving unauthorised access to IT systems and data at some international sites, with minimal production disruption.

sources.title: VOLEX | REG - Volex PLC  - Notice of Cyber Incident
sources.quote:
cyber incident which has resulted in unauthorised access to certain IT systems
and data, at some of the Group's international sites.

sources.title: VOLEX | REG - Volex PLC  - Notice of Cyber Incident
sources.quote:
Specialist, third party consultants have been engaged to
investigate the nature and extent of the incident, and to implement the
incident response plan.

sources.title: VOLEX | REG - Volex PLC  - Notice of Cyber Incident
sources.quote:
The actions taken to date have ensured that all sites remain operational, with
minimal disruption to global production levels, and the Group continues to
trade with its customers and suppliers.

positives: PT Volex Indonesia purchased renewable energy certificates from PLN Batam, sourced from the Tanjung Uma solar power plant.
